units.function: Mocked Express route tests for lightweight/bounded workspace queries and human-only branch reconciliation, operational audit projection, quarantine rescue and Agent wakeup.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Express -> execution-workspace routes -> mocked access, workspace, operation, heartbeat and activity services; no database, Git process, filesystem, durable event store or real authorization policy is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Board/Agent actors, company-scoped workspace summary/overview, reconciliation mode/reason/actor, branch/SHA/ancestry/cleanliness fingerprint, recovery action, audit comment, rescue ref and restored issue wakeup context.
units.lifecycle: Authorize/query workspace projections, or load workspace -> reject Agent reconciliation -> mutate branch state through service -> append activity details -> optionally wake restored issue assignee after quarantine recovery.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed 9/9; sandboxed execution failed 9/9 because Supertest could not bind a local port. Tests are crisp for selected route orchestration but mock authorization as universally allowed and leave most imported workspace route surfaces, failure ordering and evidence durability untested.
units.designRationale: Keep overview responses bounded, use a dedicated high-risk branch repair endpoint, deny autonomous Agents from repair modes, preserve dirty/diverged work in a rescue ref and reconnect restored work to the assigned Agent with structured recovery context.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs human-accountable recovery of corrupted execution state, with bounded inspection, non-destructive rescue, exact before/after evidence and safe resumption while keeping runtime artifacts and tenant data isolated.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the bounded overview, deterministic incoherence fingerprint, non-destructive quarantine/rescue flow, human-only floor and structured recovery wakeup. Recast reconciliation as a high-risk ActionProposal bound to Work/Attempt/ResponsibilityContract, require eligible accountable-human approval plus reason and step-up policy, and commit mutation/evidence/outbox wakeup atomically or idempotently.
units.responsibilityConflict: A generic board user may execute repair with no demonstrated accountable role or approval, while activity logging and wakeup happen after mutation without tested durability. The recorded actor omits a responsibility contract and authorization grant, so the rich operational record is not yet a complete responsibility chain.
evidence: 2026-08-19 sandboxed focused Vitest: 9/9 failed because local port binding was forbidden
units.securityFindings: HIGH authorization-evidence gap: accessService is always mocked allow and no company mismatch or denial case is asserted. HIGH high-risk-action gap: a board user can reconcile without tested accountable role, approval, reason or step-up authentication. HIGH audit durability gap: mutation precedes route activity logging and wakeup with no failure/outbox/idempotency tests. HIGH untested exposure surface: file/diff/readiness/update/operation paths and low-trust containment are absent from this route suite. MEDIUM error-contract gap: stable codes and safe structured failure responses are not asserted.
